about: N1 of observation_decision_update_v0 (as corrected in its revision_r1): a record check of Fritsche-Guenther et al. 2011 (doi 10.1038/msb.2011.27, PMC3130559, CC BY-NC-SA 3.0), Fig 4B. Performed 2026-10-08/09 by the host (Claude Code). No model was run and no comparison was made.
question: Does the authors' Fig 4B source data contain a MEK-inhibitor treatment-vs-control comparison in a BRAF-mutant line, and if so, at what level could it be compared with the current models?

read.figure: PMC3130559.1.pdf page 7, rendered with pdftoppm at 110 dpi and looked at: Figure 4 panels A, B, C
read.legend: Figure 4 legend, panels A-C (Europe PMC full-text XML cached in earlier work; the same text is printed under the figure on the rendered page)
read.methods: Materials and methods: 'Ras activity assay' and 'Immunoblotting' paragraphs; the results paragraph citing Figure 4B

sources: figure 4B blots and bars labelled HCT116 and SW480

treatment_and_control.value: AZD6244 against DMSO in the file; the blots also show an untreated lane ('ut'), which the file does not quantify
sources: figure 4B lane labels '+GTP +GDP ut AZD DMSO'
legend 4B: 'compared with untreated or vehicle controls'

time_and_concentration.value: 2 h, from the methods and the results text. Concentration: the methods' general treatment list gives '1 uM AZD6244'; the Ras activity paragraph itself states no concentration, and neither the file nor the 4B legend does.
sources: methods 'Ras activity assay': 'treatment with AZD6244 for 2 h'
results: 'cells treated with AZD6244 for 2 h'
methods general treatment list: '1 uM AZD6244'

analyte_and_readout.value: GTP-bound (active) Ras: GST-Raf-1-RBD affinity precipitation (Thermo Scientific active Ras pulldown kit), then western blot with a Ras-specific antibody

units_and_normalisation.value: Dimensionless: 'mean normalised integrated density (normalisation to DMSO control)'. DMSO is 1 with SD 0 in both lines by construction.
sources: df4B line 1: 'calculated as described in the Materials and Methods section Immunoblotting'
units_and_normalisation.not_established: Whether a loading control was applied to the pulldown bands. The Immunoblotting paragraph says intensities were normalised to Tubulin, Actin or GAPDH and expressed relative to scramble controls; how that applies to this pulldown is not stated.

per_replicate_or_summary.value: Summary only: one mean and one SD per condition. No per-replicate value is in the file.

replicates.value: 'quantification relative to DMSO for three assays' (legend). Whether the three assays are independent biological replicates, separate blots of one lysate set, or otherwise is not stated.

gtp_gdp_controls.value: GTP and GDP were added to lysates as positive and negative assay controls. They are controls of the pulldown, not treatment arms, and have no rows in the file.

sources: df4B has HCT116 and SW480 only
legend 4B names HCT116 and SW480 only
figure 4B shows HCT116 and SW480 only
braf_treatment_vs_control.not_moved_across_panels: Panel 4A has HT29 (BRAF V600E) with U0126, read as phospho-Raf-1 and Raf-1 mobility; panel 4C has CaCo2 expressing B-Raf V600E with AZD6244, read as relative pMek. Neither is a Ras-GTP measurement, and neither is used here.

data_levels.source_data_file: authors' summary of quantified western blots, normalised to DMSO (not raw instrument signal)
data_levels.figure: representative blots and bar chart of the same means and SDs; not read off for values
data_levels.text: results: 'no increase of Ras activation after abrogation of Erk activity in the Ras-mutated cells' (qualitative)

outcome.branch: A: no valid BRAF comparison in the data read
outcome.meaning: The record is not suited to N1's purpose. The path of separating M1 and M2 by Ras-GTP in BRAF-mutant lines ends here for this record. This is a check of data suitability, not a judgement update and not a model result.
not_claimed: that no Ras-GTP data for BRAF-mutant lines exist anywhere in the paper or in other public sources: only Fig 4B's file, figure, legend and the linked methods were read
that the KRAS values say anything about the BRAF-condition models
support for or against M1 or M2
outcome.model_comparison: not performed. Branch A: no BRAF observation to compare; the KRAS Ras-GTP values are already the paper's O5 statement (B06 in logic_biology_v1), and re-running a comparison on them is outside this check.
